goal: Protect wallet users from buggy or compromised external signers altering transaction outputs
Allow functional tests to verify malicious or invalid responses from external hardware signers
agreement: General support for hardening external signer PSBT processing against malicious responses
Unaddressed objection: signers can inject input sequences if PSBTv2 sequence was omitted (enessubass)
Verified by testing rejection of unsafe sighashes, finalized inputs, and mock mutations (fametrano, vicjuma)
Concept approval for hardening PSBT handling and the mock signer revamp (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it prevents external signers or bridges from altering transaction outputs or scripts undetected
Directly protects user funds against compromised devices using unsafe sighash flags to mutate transactions
